result: In 9 CFS vs 9 control women tracked by ecological momentary assessment for 2 weeks after a maximal exercise test, physical symptoms worsened only after a five-day delay, with no group difference in psychological symptoms or cognitive function.

result: COMPASS autonomic symptom score >32.5 distinguished CFS with PPV 0.96 and NPV 0.84 in a validation cohort (30 CFS, 37 controls, 60 PBC), and autonomic symptoms correlated with fatigue severity.
reason: Self-reported autonomic symptom questionnaire; no resting HR or HRV measured

result: 15 adolescents with CFS vs 57 controls had higher resting heart rate, plasma noradrenaline, adrenaline and tympanic temperature, and during hand cooling less reduction in acral skin blood flow and vasoconstriction at lower temperatures.
reason: Higher resting HR in an adolescent cohort, plus sympathetic mechanism; HRV itself not measured

result: 15 adolescents with CFS vs 57 controls had higher resting plasma noradrenaline and adrenaline, heart rate and tympanic temperature, and abnormal skin blood flow and vasoconstrictor responses to local cooling.
reason: No phenylephrine, tilt or cerebral blood flow; the measured result is raised resting plasma catecholamines in adolescents

result: In 22 monozygotic twin pairs discordant for CFS, fatigued twins had worse motor function (p=.05), processing speed (p=.02), verbal memory (p=.02) and executive function (p=.01), with intact IQ and visual memory; depression did not explain this and sudden onset was linked to slower processing (p=.01).
reason: Co-twin control design that adjusts for genetics and shared environment, replicating processing-speed deficits with intact intellect

result: A random-digit-dial survey with clinical evaluation in Georgia (5,623 respondents aged 18-59) estimated CFS prevalence at 2.54%, 6-10 times earlier population estimates, with female:male ratios of 11.2:1 metropolitan, 1.7:1 urban and 0.8:1 rural.
reason: Population prevalence well above the 0.2-1% range and a sex ratio that varied by stratum, likely reflecting broad empirical criteria

result: In 15 CFS patients without psychiatric comorbidity, the percentage suppression of salivary cortisol and urinary cortisol metabolites after 5 mg prednisolone was significantly greater than in controls.
reason: Glucocorticoid challenge showing exaggerated suppression, the same measure and direction as the finding
